products.title: Trapped! The Aron Ralston story
products.describtion: Aron Ralston is a famous traveler, climber and writer. He was educated as an engineer and his future life promised to be not too exciting and extreme. Once Aron realizes that everything is turning into something boring and monotonous. He does not like this. The young man needs some changes.

products.title: Hard Times for the Time Trippers
products.describtion: Matt Johnson woke up in the middle of the night. The same nightmare tormented him again and again. In the dream, he came home after school. There was one day before the holidays.

products.title: The Card
products.describtion: If you want to become as successful as possible, what qualities will you need first of all? Will the smartest person be the most successful? Or good looks and charisma are the things you need

products.title: The Murder at the Vicarage
products.describtion: Colonel Protheroe was not a good man. He had lots of enemies. So when he was found shot at the vicarage, many people became murder suspects. It could be his daughter Lettice who wanted to get freedom from the strict father and inherit his fortune.
